partial_progress.details: Research report delivered. Verdict: MT/MS4/MS5 completeness is TRACTABLE and zero-debt, mirroring IK/task-494 (not blocked like CK/task-501).

handoff.verdict: MT/MS4/MS5 completeness TRACTABLE and zero-debt; mirrors IK/task-494 birelational positive-FC-closure pattern, does NOT inherit CS4/CS5 (task-501) segment-model blocker.
key_findings: MK reuses IK's single-world two-clause minCanonicalR over quasi-prime worlds WITH F1/F2 confluence (MValid), not CK's segment model.
Frame conditions are PLAIN on raw r (reflexive/transitive/symmetric), NOT the CK ≤-composed form; F1/F2 absorb the ≤-composition in box-form soundness (as MK.idb uses f2).
FC closures are positive (min_axiom_mem + min_imp_property via QuasiPrime.closed deductive closure); no consistency, no efq, no world-subtype invariant, no diamRefutingSegment.
mk_completeness is already single-branch, so mkvalidFC_completeness is simpler than IK's ivalidFC_completeness (no inconsistent/efq branch).
Axiomatize MS5 via B (symmetry), NOT euclidean-5 (quasi-prime theories are far from negation-complete).
No new Mathlib API; do NOT use deprecated Mathlib Reflexive/Transitive/Symmetric — define local mtFC/ms4FC/ms5FC predicates.
handoff.zero_debt: No sorry/axiom/vacuous-def recommended. Phases 3 and 4 carry explicit STOP/[BLOCKED]-escalation clauses; confidence a sorry-free construction exists is HIGH (verbatim ports of already-compiled IK it_/is4_/is5_canonical_* proofs).
